$comment: Transcribed by hand from owner-supplied screenshots of a third-party Behance illustration (undated). STATUS: UNVERIFIED LEADS FOR OWNER REVIEW ONLY — not applied data. The illustration must never by itself name, number or position a real footprint, and no official LPU block number may be inferred solely from location or appearance. Captions are quoted as printed (typos kept) only for block number <-> function facts; no artwork is reproduced. shapeNotes describe the drawing, for later human-checked matching against OSM footprints. No OSM/repo data was read or modified to produce this file.

scenes.caption: OPEN AUDITORIUM AND SURROUNDINGS
scenes.contents: Large grey perforated pavilion roof on columns with solar panels (pin 16); wedge building (pin 15); block with tree row (pin 14); block on the right (pin 18); tree-lined road and green strips with a row of flag poles upper-left; blue covered walkway; a clipped, illegible pin at the bottom edge.

scenes.caption: PLAYGROUND
scenes.contents: Cricket oval with pitch (pin 52 on the oval), tennis courts and basketball courts, open football fields, a parking strip full of cars along the outer road; pins 57, 56, 55 (crescent), 54, 53 (hostel complex), 51, 48; a '58' pin clipped at the left edge; water tower and round green tanks.

scenes.caption: DILDO PARK
scenes.contents: Rectangular walled lawn with trees and a paved patch in the middle, between a grey building and a road. No pins. Caption transcribed exactly as printed; its meaning is unclear (possibly a joke or misprint) and it must not be used as a place name without independent confirmation.

scenes.caption: GARDEN AREA
scenes.contents: Rectangular garden with a regular grid of shrubs/trees; pin 4 on the grey comb-fronted building; pin 5 on a red building corner across the road; red brick building and tree-lined road upper-left.

scenes.caption: FLAG AREA
scenes.contents: Tall flagpole with the Indian flag, square garden with a statue on a plinth, benches and lamps; shrub grid; arched covered walkway/building with staircase upper-left; large lawn with one big tree and a small red hut.

scenes.caption: UNIVERSITY ENTRENCE
scenes.contents: Title slide 'LPU MAP' with an entrance vignette: tall gate tower with emblem, multi-lane gate canopy (toll-booth style), a second gate with a slim pylon and low red buildings, tree-lined roads. 'ENTRENCE' is a typo for 'Entrance'.

scenes.caption: PARKING AREA AND GARDEN AREA
scenes.contents: Large parking lot full of cars, lawn with a big tree and a small red hut, landscaped entrance lanes with the gate tower.

scenes.caption: (overview map; INFORMATION index; legend)
